jobs.description:
Do you possess an IRATA Level 3 certificate, are you technically skilled, and do you enjoy working at heights? Do you enjoy leading and supervising operational teams, with a keen eye for safety and quality, and do you also like to roll up your sleeves? Furthermore, do you have an affinity for technical work and various industries, and are you up for working on the most challenging projects in hard-to-reach locations, such as at height and in confined spaces? Then this position as Rope Access Technician/Supervisor at Sky-Access B.V. is exactly what you are looking for! Company is based in Roosendaal.

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone:

• With a valid IRATA level 3 certificate (hard demand)
• Who enjoys being physically active in their work
• Who has an affinity for working safely, the various industries, and technology
• With a flexible and positive work attitude, a team player
• Who has technical insight and enjoys working with their hands
• With a technical background
• With the necessary capabilities and ambition to take responsibility for rope safety on the projects
• Who takes initiative, both solicited and unsolicited, and provides advice on IRATA-related knowledge, skills, and methodologies
• Who is willing to work occasionally at irregular times (weekends/nights)
• With a good command of English
• Who holds a B driving license
• With VCA-VOL certification (or willing to obtain it)

________________________________________

What do we offer you?
• Contract duration: Intention is a permanent contract. First year a fixed term contract of 12 months (will be changed into a permanent contract if skills, performance and work attitude are meeting company demands)
Trial period: 1 month
Salary range (gross/month): €3.500 – €4.000 in accordance with the Collective Labour Agreement for the Small Metal Industry
Housing: Employer offers suitable housing for the first period (to help the foreign colleque) – for this a contribution of the costs are for the account of employee (cost indication: between € 500 and € 600)
• A varied and challenging job within an enthusiastic and close-knit team
• Ample opportunities for personal development (IRATA upgrades, courses, advancement to project manager, IRATA part-time roles)
• Working on unique and technically challenging projects, both nationally and internationally
• Support and guidance in your career and certification processes
• A no-nonsense company culture with a focus on safety and quality

SSAB Services, Hardox Wearparts is a rapidly growing business unit with ambitious targets. As Business & Technical Development Manager for Hardox Wearparts you will be an integral part of building and implementing a new business model. 

You will participate in the development and conceptualization of the new business model, including the future product and service mix as well as the go-to market setup. Placement is optional.

Responsibilities include

•Business concept: Conceptualization and structuring of existing knowledge in order to define the  service offer

•Product and service portfolio evaluation and definition

•Development of trainings and manuals

•Piloting the new concept, preparing for future concept sales

•Mapping end user needs to ensure concept success

You will report to the Head of Hardox Wearparts Concept Management.

Your qualifications
To be successful in this role you need to have a master degree in engineering or equivalent. 

We believe that you have at least 5 years experience of working with wear products and/or maintenance in the one of the aggregates industries. You have strong social skills and experience from successfully driving and implementing development. 

You have a curious mind and strong analytical skills paired with good technical understanding of wear in practice (maintenance and wear products). As a lot of the future development will have a strong connection to digital tools and systems development, you need an overall understanding of the possibilities that exist within digital development. 

You are fluent in English and thrive in an international environment where global contacts are part of the every day work. Speaking Dutch is a plus as the position wil be based in the Netherlands.

As a person you are positive and interested in new ideas - and in making them happen. 

We offer
You will be part of, and have the possibility to grow within, an international and dynamic organization that is developing rapidly. Hardox Wearparts has ambitious growth targets and as a vital member of the development team, you will contribute to our future success. 

Application
Send your application no later than 20th of March 2019

For more information, please contact
Nancy Matos, Manager Hardox Wearparts Concept, phone +46 155 255 422

Suitsupply is a market defining brand showing strong international growth.

We are pioneers at everything we do, and we work hard to keep it that way. Our pioneering spirit generates a contagious energy, which is what enables us to keep putting new ideas into practice. Our strength lies in our formula: straight, to the point and still personal. Fast and effective. Combining craftsmanship with flair.

Suitsupply has over 60 stores in 15 different countries; the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, Italy, the United Kingdom, Belarus, Latvia, Lithuania, Canada, Mexico, China, Russia, Singapore and the United States. We recently opened stores in Austin, Tysons and Seoul and soon we’ll open our doors in LA West Hollywood and many more…

This job might be for you if you have:

• Minimal 4 years’ experience in retail construction, hotel and/or restaurant design
• Master’s Degree in Architectural Design or related field
• Proficient in Vectorworks and Photoshop software
• Fluency in English

Our architecture design department is the high-performance engine that ensures we build outstanding and innovative stores across the world. As we are expanding rapidly, we are seeking for an Interior Architect with experience in retail construction projects.

Requirements:
• fluency in Swedish
• Excellent communication skills: verbal, written, listening, probing & reading
• Fair Knowledge on PC Operating Systems
• Knowledge and experience with Microsoft office  
• Ability to employ a high level of interpersonal and communication skills to move beyond customer frustrations to solve customer problems
• Ability to employ patience and self-control in handling irate customers
• Ability to follow proper procedures and work within established guidelines
• Analytical problem solving skills; linear and logical troubleshooting skills
• Ability to set expectations and deliver information in a positive way
• Adapts well to changing circumstances, direction, and strategy
• Keen to develop, with an ability to learn quickly and adapt in a high change environment
• Keep up to date with relevant industry technology, like to work in an environment where the pace can change but the customers always remain in focus
• Be able to work as part of a strong and collaborative team

 We are looking for technically minded professionals, fluent in Swedish and English language who are positive, friendly and enjoy making customers smile! If this sounds like you, then here is your chance to join an IT orientated support team dedicated to caring for the customers of one of the most recognized computer software brands in the world.

You will receive first class training, to further your skills in customer care and information technology, as part of an award-winning team, with rewarding career paths.

You will benefit from 25 days paid holiday, incentives, Relocation assistance, discounts, on-site restaurant and free parking. There are also lots of fun, social activities and team events for you to get involved in!

Role & Responsibilities:
• Provide effective and efficient first-line technical support for basic or routine incoming service inquiries (answer questions, solve problems and perform basic troubleshooting using provided scripting and published materials)
• Deliver timely, accurate customer support with a high degree of customer service satisfaction
• Document customer interactions with accurate call logging
• Deliver technical assistance based on instruction and pre-established guidelines
• Deliver individual performance based on metrics and related targets, such as average handle time, resolution, and customer satisfaction
• Be a central part of identifying improvement opportunities
• Successfully complete training activities to maintain technical and product knowledge
• Participate in coaching and demonstrate commitment to personal improvement
• Prioritize daily tasks, prepare personal schedule and monitor/adjust to complete tasks
 Convergys is a global contact centre business, with more than 125,000 employees working from more than 150 locations in 31 countries around the world.  Our clients are many of the most recognizable brands in the world, and our success is thanks to our people who manage billions of customer interactions every year.  We’re always looking to add positive, motivated individuals to our team – people who are eager to learn our business, grow in their careers and advance within our company.
